title: Every subset of a Noetherian topological space is compact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space has the descending-chain condition on closed subsets (so it is Noetherian). Then every subset $A\subseteq |X|$ is quasi-compact: every open cover of $A$ has a finite subcover.
